question: left{ (12)/(9-6) right} + 8 - ( { {16} over 4} ) - (3 - 5 - 4) is equal to:
solution:
Given:​

left{ (12)/(9-6) right} + 8 - ( { {16} over 4} )- (3 - 5 - 4)

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cc8f63640c17e5af9cdfc3b1e0aec219549b666eec21d379b8feb7bd6c52eb4.png] 

Calculation:

left{ (12)/(9-6) right} + 8 - ( { {16} over 4} )- (3 - 5 - 4)

⇒ 12/3 + 8 - 4 - (3 - 5 - 4)

⇒ 4 + 8 - 4 + 6

⇒ 14

∴ The required answer is 14.
